title: Design Context Graph
description: The canonical typed knowledge graph of a design system, persisted at .design/context-graph.json. Nodes are design entities (tokens, components, screens, patterns); edges are typed relationships between them (uses-token, composes, transitions-to). Built by a two-phase mapper: a deterministic extract pass emits node/edge skeletons, then an LLM summary pass fills each node summary. Validated structurally by scripts/validate-design-context.cjs and queried by scripts/lib/design-context-query.cjs.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this graph document (e.g. "52.0").

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the graph was last assembled (optional).

nodes.description: All design entities in the graph. Node ids must be unique.

edges.description: All typed relationships. Every source/target must resolve to a node id.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the node (referenced by edge source/target).

type.description: The kind of design entity this node represents.

summary.description: One-line LLM-authored description of what the entity is and does. A stub summary (empty or identical to name) is flagged by the validator as a soft warning.

tags.description: Controlled-vocabulary tags grouping the node by concern (see reference/design-context-tag-vocab.md). Unknown tags are a soft warning, not a hard error.

complexity.description: Coarse complexity bucket for the entity.

subtype.description: Optional finer classification. For token nodes one of color/spacing/typography/radius/shadow; for layer nodes one of Atomic/Molecular/Organism/Template. Free-form for other node types.

source.description: Node id the edge originates from.

target.description: Node id the edge points to.

type.description: The kind of relationship between source and target.

direction.description: Whether the relationship reads source-to-target (forward), target-to-source (backward), or both ways (bidirectional).

weight.description: Relationship strength in the inclusive range 0..1.
